/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Temporal
  The temporal operators over a whole trace at once: every operator maps per-instant arrays to a
  per-instant array in one pass (or one pass plus O(1) window queries), so a formula costs
  O(|φ| · n log n) per grounding. Semantics and Derived both use these; nothing here knows what
  a formula or a road user is.

  Finite-trace policy: the unobserved past and future are unknown (`windowTruncated`), never a
  verdict. A lookback window must be covered and adequately sampled; a lookahead window is true
  on a witness, false only when covered.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Time
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Unknown

namespace TrafficSpec
namespace Temporal

def const (n : Nat) (r : R) : Array R := Array.replicate n r
def truncated (op : String) : R := R.u (.windowTruncated op)

-- pointwise connectives
def zipAnd (a b : Array R) : Array R := Array.zipWith R.and a b
def zipOr (a b : Array R) : Array R := Array.zipWith R.or a b
def zipImplies (a b : Array R) : Array R := Array.zipWith R.implies a b
def mapNot (a : Array R) : Array R := a.map R.not
def allOf (n : Nat) (xs : List (Array R)) : Array R := xs.foldl zipAnd (const n R.t)
def anyOf (n : Nat) (xs : List (Array R)) : Array R := xs.foldl zipOr (const n R.f)

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Unbounded operators: one backward or forward pass with the unobserved tail as unknown.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
private def backward (tail : R) (step : R → R → R) (vals : Array R) : Array R :=
  let n := vals.size
  ((List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
    let r := step vals[i]! acc.2
    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n tail, tail)).1

private def forward (head : R) (step : R → R → R) (vals : Array R) : Array R :=
  let n := vals.size
  ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
    let r := step vals[i]! acc.2
    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n head, head)).1

/-- `always φ`: φ here and at every later observation, and the unobserved future. -/
def alwaysAll (φ : Array R) : Array R := backward (truncated "always") R.and φ
/-- `eventually φ`: φ here or later, or the unobserved future. -/
def eventuallyAll (φ : Array R) : Array R := backward (truncated "eventually") R.or φ
/-- Strong until: `ψ ∨ (φ ∧ until')`, the unobserved future as the tail. -/
def untilAll (φ ψ : Array R) : Array R :=
  let n := ψ.size
  ((List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
    let r := R.or ψ[i]! (R.and φ[i]! acc.2)
    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n (truncated "until"), truncated "until")).1
/-- Since: `ψ ∨ (φ ∧ since')`, the unobserved past as the head. -/
def sinceAll (φ ψ : Array R) : Array R :=
  let n := ψ.size
  ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
    let r := R.or ψ[i]! (R.and φ[i]! acc.2)
    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n (truncated "since"), truncated "since")).1
/-- `once φ`: φ here or at some earlier observation, or the unobserved past. -/
def onceAll (φ : Array R) : Array R := forward (truncated "once") (fun v acc => R.or v acc) φ
/-- φ at the previous observation (`first` at the trace start). -/
def prevAll (first : R) (φ : Array R) : Array R :=
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i => if i = 0 then first else φ[i - 1]!

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Metric windows: positions per instant (time or path), a length d, per-instant values.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- φ at every observation in the window of length `d` behind each instant. Unknown where a
    position inside the window is missing; where the window is not covered, false on a false
    already observed inside it and unknown otherwise; unknown where it is covered but not
    adequately sampled. -/
def holdsForAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason) (φ : Array R) : Array R :=
  let wins := Time.backWindows pos d
  let agg := RangeAgg.build φ
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
    match wins[i]! with
    | none => R.u missing
    | some w =>
      if !w.covered then (if (agg.all w.j0 i).v = .f then R.f else truncated op)
      else if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op)
      else agg.all w.j0 i

/-- The value of φ at the latest observation `j` in `[j0, i]` at which ψ held: unknown where ψ is
    unknown at an observation later than any at which it held; none where ψ held nowhere in the range. -/
private def atLastAt (ψ φ : Array R) (j0 i : Nat) : Option R :=
  (List.range (i + 1 - j0)).foldl (fun (acc : Option R) k =>
    match acc with
    | some r => some r
    | none =>
      let j := i - k
      match ψ[j]!.v with
      | .t => some φ[j]!
      | .u => some ⟨.u, ψ[j]!.why⟩
      | .f => none) none

/-- φ at the last observation in the window of length `d` behind each instant at which ψ held.
    Unknown where a position is missing, where ψ is unknown later than any observation at which it
    held, where the window is not adequately sampled (an unobserved later instant could be the last
    one at which ψ held), and where ψ held nowhere in a window that is not covered; false where ψ
    held nowhere in a covered, adequately sampled window. -/
def atLastAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason) (ψ φ : Array R) : Array R :=
  let wins := Time.backWindows pos d
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
    match wins[i]! with
    | none => R.u missing
    | some w =>
      match atLastAt ψ φ w.j0 i with
      | some r => if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op) else r
      | none => if !w.covered then truncated op else if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op) else R.f

/-- φ at some observation in the window of length `d` ahead: true on a witness, false only when
    the window is covered, unknown when it runs off the trace. -/
def withinAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason) (φ : Array R) : Array R :=
  let wins := Time.forwardWindows pos d
  let agg := RangeAgg.build φ
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
    match wins[i]! with
    | none => R.u missing
    | some w =>
      if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op)
      else
        let a := agg.any i w.jl
        if w.covered then a else R.or a (truncated op)

/-- Smallest `k ≥ i` whose value satisfies `p` (size when none), per instant. -/
def nextWhere (vals : Array R) (p : Tri → Bool) : Array Nat :=
  let n := vals.size
  (List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i =>
    acc.set! i (if p vals[i]!.v then i else acc[i + 1]!)) (Array.replicate (n + 1) n)

/-- Strong until restricted to the window ahead: ∃ j in the window, ψ at j and φ at every
    observation from here to just before j; the unobserved remainder counts as unknown unless φ
    already failed. -/
def untilWithinAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason) (φ ψ : Array R) : Array R :=
  let wins := Time.forwardWindows pos d
  let aggφ := RangeAgg.build φ
  let aggψ := RangeAgg.build ψ
  let firstψ := nextWhere ψ (· = .t)
  let firstφf := nextWhere φ (· = .f)
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
    match wins[i]! with
    | none => R.u missing
    | some w =>
      if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op)
      else
        let b := firstψ[i]!
        -- φ at every observation from i up to, not including, b (empty when b = i)
        let φBefore (b : Nat) : R := if b ≤ i then R.t else aggφ.all i (b - 1)
        let witnessed : R :=
          if b ≤ w.jl && (φBefore b).v = .t then R.t
          else
            -- false only if every candidate fails: ψ false up to the first φ failure (or the window end)
            let a := firstφf[i]!
            let hi := min a w.jl
            let ψany := aggψ.any i hi
            if ψany.v = .f then R.f
            else
              let why := (if ψany.v = .u then ψany.why else []) ++
                (if b ≤ w.jl then (φBefore b).why else [])
              ⟨.u, if why.isEmpty then [.windowTruncated op] else why⟩
        if w.covered then witnessed
        else R.or witnessed (R.and (truncated op) (aggφ.all i w.jl))

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Runs and counts
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- The first instant of the latest run of true values ending at the latest true instant ≤ i:
    "since φ became true". `none` before any true; an error where an unknown value hides the
    run's start, and `windowTruncated op` where the run reaches the trace start (it may have
    begun before the recording). -/
def runStartAll (op : String) (vals : Array R) : Array (Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) :=
  let n := vals.size
  ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array (Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) × Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) i =>
    let v := vals[i]!
    let st : Except UnknownReason (Option Nat) :=
      match v.v with
      | .t =>
        if i = 0 then .error (.windowTruncated op)
        else match vals[i - 1]!.v with
          | .t => acc.2
          | .f => .ok (some i)
          | .u => .error (vals[i - 1]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed op))
      | .f => acc.2
      | .u => .error (v.why.head?.getD (.malformed op))
    (acc.1.push st, st)) (Array.mkEmpty n, .ok none)).1

/-- Path length over which `holds` has held continuously up to each instant: zero where it does
    not hold, unknown where it is unknown, where the path length is missing, or where the run
    reaches the trace start. -/
def distanceWhileAll (pathPos : Array (Option Q)) (holds : Array R) : Array QR :=
  let starts := runStartAll "distance_while" holds
  (Array.range holds.size).map fun i =>
    match holds[i]!.v with
    | .f => .ok Q.zero
    | .u => .error (holds[i]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed "distance_while"))
    | .t =>
      match starts[i]! with
      | .error e => .error e
      | .ok none => .error (.windowTruncated "distance_while")
      | .ok (some j) =>
        match pathPos[i]!, pathPos[j]! with
        | some pi, some pj => .ok (Q.sub pi pj)
        | _, _ => .error (.absentAtom "kin_path_length")

/-- Rising edges of `edge` since the start of the latest run of `sinceφ`, per instant. -/
def countEdgesAll (op : String) (edge sinceφ : Array R) : Array (Except UnknownReason Nat) :=
  let n := edge.size
  let starts := runStartAll op sinceφ
  -- edge k: true when edge[k] = t and edge[k-1] = f; unknown when either is unknown
  let edgeVal : Array (Except UnknownReason Bool) := (Array.range n).map fun k =>
    if k = 0 then .ok false
    else match edge[k]!.v, edge[k - 1]!.v with
      | .u, _ => .error (edge[k]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed "count"))
      | _, .u => .error (edge[k - 1]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed "count"))
      | .t, .f => .ok true
      | _, _ => .ok false
  let prefT := (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) k =>
    acc.push (acc[k]! + (match edgeVal[k]! with | .ok true => 1 | _ => 0))) #[0]
  let prefU := (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) k =>
    acc.push (acc[k]! + (match edgeVal[k]! with | .error _ => 1 | _ => 0))) #[0]
  let nextU := (List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) k =>
    acc.set! k (match edgeVal[k]! with | .error _ => k | _ => acc[k + 1]!)) (Array.replicate (n + 1) n)
  (Array.range n).map fun i =>
    match starts[i]! with
    | .error e => .error e
    | .ok none => .error (.windowTruncated op)
    | .ok (some j) =>
      -- edges at k ∈ (j, i]
      if prefU[i + 1]! - prefU[j + 1]! > 0 then
        match edgeVal[nextU[j + 1]!]! with | .error e => .error e | _ => .error (.malformed op)
      else .ok (prefT[i + 1]! - prefT[j + 1]!)

/-- φ here and not at the previous observation, as a three-valued conjunction: false where φ is
    false here, or true at the previous observation; true where φ is true here and false before;
    unknown otherwise, with the reasons of the values it could not settle, the unobserved past
    before the first observation among them. -/
def risesAll (φ : Array R) : Array R :=
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
    R.and φ[i]! (R.not (if i = 0 then truncated "rises" else φ[i - 1]!))

/-- Seconds since φ last became true: from the start of the latest run of true values; unknown
    where that run reaches the trace start or none is observed. -/
def sinceRiseAll (times : Array Q) (φ : Array R) : Array QR :=
  let starts := runStartAll "since_rise" φ
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
    match starts[i]! with
    | .error e => .error e
    | .ok none => .error (.windowTruncated "since_rise")
    | .ok (some j) => .ok (Q.sub times[i]! times[j]!)

/-- First instant ≤ i at which `vals` is true; an error if an unknown precedes it. A first true at
    index 0 is an upper bound on the true onset, which the caller must treat as such. -/
def firstTrueAll (vals : Array R) : Array (Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) :=
  let n := vals.size
  ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array (Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) × Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) i =>
    let st : Except UnknownReason (Option Nat) :=
      match acc.2 with
      | .ok (some j) => .ok (some j)
      | .error e => .error e
      | .ok none =>
        match vals[i]!.v with
        | .t => .ok (some i)
        | .f => .ok none
        | .u => .error (vals[i]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed "first"))
    (acc.1.push st, st)) (Array.mkEmpty n, .ok none)).1


-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Lengths: every operator returns one value per observation of the array it walks.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
section Lengths

/-- A left fold whose step keeps the length of the array it carries keeps the initial length. -/
theorem size_foldl_carry {α β : Type} (l : List Nat) (f : Array α × β → Nat → Array α × β)
    (hf : ∀ acc i, (f acc i).1.size = acc.1.size) (init : Array α × β) :
    (l.foldl f init).1.size = init.1.size := by
  induction l generalizing init with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih => simp only [List.foldl]; rw [ih, hf]

theorem size_const (n : Nat) (r : R) : (const n r).size = n := by simp [const]
theorem size_zipAnd (a b : Array R) : (zipAnd a b).size = min a.size b.size := by simp [zipAnd]
theorem size_zipOr (a b : Array R) : (zipOr a b).size = min a.size b.size := by simp [zipOr]
theorem size_zipImplies (a b : Array R) : (zipImplies a b).size = min a.size b.size := by simp [zipImplies]
theorem size_mapNot (a : Array R) : (mapNot a).size = a.size := by simp [mapNot]

private theorem size_backward (tail : R) (step : R → R → R) (vals : Array R) :
    (backward tail step vals).size = vals.size := by
  unfold backward; rw [size_foldl_carry] <;> simp

private theorem size_forward (head : R) (step : R → R → R) (vals : Array R) :
    (forward head step vals).size = vals.size := by
  unfold forward; rw [size_foldl_carry] <;> simp

theorem size_alwaysAll (φ : Array R) : (alwaysAll φ).size = φ.size := size_backward _ _ _
theorem size_eventuallyAll (φ : Array R) : (eventuallyAll φ).size = φ.size := size_backward _ _ _
theorem size_onceAll (φ : Array R) : (onceAll φ).size = φ.size := size_forward _ _ _
theorem size_untilAll (φ ψ : Array R) : (untilAll φ ψ).size = ψ.size := by
  unfold untilAll; rw [size_foldl_carry] <;> simp
theorem size_sinceAll (φ ψ : Array R) : (sinceAll φ ψ).size = ψ.size := by
  unfold sinceAll; rw [size_foldl_carry] <;> simp
theorem size_prevAll (first : R) (φ : Array R) : (prevAll first φ).size = φ.size := by simp [prevAll]
theorem size_holdsForAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (w : UnknownReason) (φ : Array R) :
    (holdsForAll pos d op w φ).size = φ.size := by simp [holdsForAll]
theorem size_atLastAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (w : UnknownReason) (ψ φ : Array R) :
    (atLastAll pos d op w ψ φ).size = φ.size := by simp [atLastAll]
theorem size_withinAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (w : UnknownReason) (φ : Array R) :
    (withinAll pos d op w φ).size = φ.size := by simp [withinAll]
theorem size_untilWithinAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (w : UnknownReason) (φ ψ : Array R) :
    (untilWithinAll pos d op w φ ψ).size = φ.size := by simp [untilWithinAll]
theorem size_distanceWhileAll (pathPos : Array (Option Q)) (holds : Array R) :
    (distanceWhileAll pathPos holds).size = holds.size := by simp [distanceWhileAll]
theorem size_countEdgesAll (op : String) (edge sinceφ : Array R) :
    (countEdgesAll op edge sinceφ).size = edge.size := by simp [countEdgesAll]
theorem size_risesAll (φ : Array R) : (risesAll φ).size = φ.size := by simp [risesAll]
theorem size_sinceRiseAll (times : Array Q) (φ : Array R) : (sinceRiseAll times φ).size = φ.size := by
  simp [sinceRiseAll]

end Lengths

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- A window that reaches past the trace start: false only on an observed false, else unknown.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
section HoldsFor

theorem holdsForAll_getElem! (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason)
    (φ : Array R) (i : Nat) (hi : i < φ.size) :
    (holdsForAll pos d op missing φ)[i]! =
      match (Time.backWindows pos d)[i]! with
      | none => R.u missing
      | some w =>
        if !w.covered then (if ((RangeAgg.build φ).all w.j0 i).v = .f then R.f else truncated op)
        else if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op)
        else (RangeAgg.build φ).all w.j0 i := by
  unfold holdsForAll
  rw [getElem!_pos _ i (by simpa using hi)]
  simp

/-- At an instant whose window is not covered, a false observation `j` with `w.j0 ≤ j ≤ i` makes
    the result false. -/
theorem holdsForAll_uncovered_of_f (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason)
    (φ : Array R) (i : Nat) (w : Time.Back) (hi : i < φ.size) (hw : (Time.backWindows pos d)[i]! = some w)
    (hc : w.covered = false) (j : Nat) (hj0 : w.j0 ≤ j) (hji : j ≤ i) (hf : φ[j]!.v = .f) :
    (holdsForAll pos d op missing φ)[i]! = R.f := by
  rw [holdsForAll_getElem! pos d op missing φ i hi, hw]
  simp [hc, RangeAgg.all_f_of_witness φ w.j0 i j hi hj0 hji hf, R.f]

/-- At an instant whose window is not covered and holds no false observation in `[w.j0, i]`, the
    result is the truncation, with its reason. -/
theorem holdsForAll_uncovered_of_no_f (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason)
    (φ : Array R) (i : Nat) (w : Time.Back) (hi : i < φ.size) (hw : (Time.backWindows pos d)[i]! = some w)
    (hc : w.covered = false) (hn : ∀ j, w.j0 ≤ j → j ≤ i → φ[j]!.v ≠ .f) :
    (holdsForAll pos d op missing φ)[i]! = truncated op := by
  rw [holdsForAll_getElem! pos d op missing φ i hi, hw]
  have : ((RangeAgg.build φ).all w.j0 i).v ≠ .f := fun hf =>
    let ⟨j, h1, h2, _, h3⟩ := RangeAgg.all_f_witness φ w.j0 i hf
    hn j h1 h2 h3
  simp [hc, this]

/-- A false at an instant whose window is not covered has a false observation inside the window. -/
theorem holdsForAll_uncovered_f (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason)
    (φ : Array R) (i : Nat) (w : Time.Back) (hi : i < φ.size) (hw : (Time.backWindows pos d)[i]! = some w)
    (hc : w.covered = false) (hf : (holdsForAll pos d op missing φ)[i]!.v = .f) :
    ∃ j, w.j0 ≤ j ∧ j ≤ i ∧ j < φ.size ∧ φ[j]!.v = .f := by
  rw [holdsForAll_getElem! pos d op missing φ i hi, hw] at hf
  simp only [hc, Bool.not_false, if_true] at hf
  split at hf
  · obtain ⟨j, h1, h2, _, h3⟩ := RangeAgg.all_f_witness φ w.j0 i ‹_›
    exact ⟨j, h1, h2, by omega, h3⟩
  · simp [truncated, R.u] at hf

end HoldsFor

end Temporal
end TrafficSpec

22	import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.World

27	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
28	-- Geometry helpers for the `rel_*` atoms (exact rationals; the one square root is an integer
29	-- square root at micrometre resolution).
30	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
31	namespace Geom
32	def vsub (a b : Vec) : Vec := (Q.sub a.1 b.1, Q.sub a.2 b.2)
33	def vadd (a b : Vec) : Vec := (Q.add a.1 b.1, Q.add a.2 b.2)
34	def dot (a b : Vec) : Q := Q.add (Q.mul a.1 b.1) (Q.mul a.2 b.2)
35	/-- 2-D cross product `a × b`; positive when `b` is to the left of `a`. -/
36	def cross (a b : Vec) : Q := Q.sub (Q.mul a.1 b.2) (Q.mul a.2 b.1)
37	def normSq (a : Vec) : Q := dot a a
38	/-- Square root of a non-negative quantity in metres, floored to micrometres. -/
39	def sqrtMicro (q : Q) : Q :=
40	  if q.num ≤ 0 then Q.zero
41	  else
42	    let scaled : Int := (q.num * 1000000000000) / (q.den : Int)   -- µm²
43	    Units.micrometres (Int.ofNat (isqrt scaled.toNat))
44	def norm (a : Vec) : Q := sqrtMicro (normSq a)
45	/-- The unit vector along `a`; `none` for the zero vector only. `a` is first divided by its larger
46	    absolute component, so the vector normalised has length between 1 and √2 whatever `a`'s scale,
47	    and then by that length taken to micrometres (`norm`). The result is the exact unit vector times
48	    a factor of at least 1 and below 1 + 2·10⁻⁶, and is exact where the scaled length is a whole
49	    number of micrometres (every axis-aligned direction). -/
50	def unit (a : Vec) : Option Vec :=
51	  let m := Q.max (Q.abs a.1) (Q.abs a.2)
52	  if Q.isZero m then none
53	  else
54	    let b := (Q.div a.1 m, Q.div a.2 m)
55	    let n := norm b
56	    some (Q.div b.1 n, Q.div b.2 n)
57	/-- Components of `v` in the frame of heading `h` (longitudinal, lateral); lateral positive = left.
58	    `h` is read as a direction (`unit`), whatever its length; `v` keeps its own. -/
59	def inFrame (h v : Vec) : Option (Q × Q) := do
60	  let u ← unit h
61	  pure (dot u v, cross u v)
62	/-- Distance from a point to a segment. -/
63	def segmentDistance (p a b : Vec) : Q :=

-- Geometry helpers for the `rel_*` atoms (exact rationals; the one square root is an integer
-- square root at micrometre resolution).

namespace Geom
def vsub (a b : Vec) : Vec := (Q.sub a.1 b.1, Q.sub a.2 b.2)
def vadd (a b : Vec) : Vec := (Q.add a.1 b.1, Q.add a.2 b.2)
def dot (a b : Vec) : Q := Q.add (Q.mul a.1 b.1) (Q.mul a.2 b.2)
/-- 2-D cross product `a × b`; positive when `b` is to the left of `a`. -/
def cross (a b : Vec) : Q := Q.sub (Q.mul a.1 b.2) (Q.mul a.2 b.1)
def normSq (a : Vec) : Q := dot a a
/-- Square root of a non-negative quantity in metres, floored to micrometres. -/
def sqrtMicro (q : Q) : Q :=
  if q.num ≤ 0 then Q.zero
  else
    let scaled : Int := (q.num * 1000000000000) / (q.den : Int)   -- µm²
    Units.micrometres (Int.ofNat (isqrt scaled.toNat))
def norm (a : Vec) : Q := sqrtMicro (normSq a)
/-- The unit vector along `a`; `none` for the zero vector only. `a` is first divided by its larger
    absolute component, so the vector normalised has length between 1 and √2 whatever `a`'s scale,
    and then by that length taken to micrometres (`norm`). The result is the exact unit vector times
    a factor of at least 1 and below 1 + 2·10⁻⁶, and is exact where the scaled length is a whole
    number of micrometres (every axis-aligned direction). -/
def unit (a : Vec) : Option Vec :=
  let m := Q.max (Q.abs a.1) (Q.abs a.2)

def inFrame (h v : Vec) : Option (Q × Q) := do

/-- Whether a point lies inside a polygon (ray casting), for footprint-in-region tests. -/
def inPolygon (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
  let n := poly.length

  else
    let edges := (List.range n).map fun i => (poly[i]!, poly[(i + 1) % n]!)
    let crossings := edges.filter fun (a, b) =>
      let (ax, ay) := a; let (bx, by_) := b

        -- x-intersection of the edge with the horizontal line through p, compared with p.x

def orient (a b c : Vec) : Int :=

/-- Whether `p` lies on the closed segment `ab`, given that it lies on its line. -/
def withinBox (p a b : Vec) : Bool :=

def segmentsIntersect (a b c d : Vec) : Bool :=

/-- The edges of a polygon, the last vertex closing to the first. -/
def edges (poly : List Vec) : List (Vec × Vec) :=
  let n := poly.length

/-- Whether two polygons share a point as closed sets: an edge of one meets an edge of the other

def polygonsOverlap (p q : List Vec) : Bool :=

/-- Distance from a point to a polygon's boundary: zero inside, the nearest edge outside. -/

/-- The point of a segment nearest a point. -/

    distance is the least, so a tie keeps every equally near point whatever the vertex order. -/
def nearestPoints (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : List Vec :=

/-- The vector from the nearest point of polygon `p` to the nearest point of polygon `q`: zero when
    they share a point (`polygonsOverlap`), otherwise the shortest vector joining a vertex of one to
    the nearest point of the other's boundary, which for two convex polygons is the same for every
    nearest pair. `none` for an empty polygon. -/
def nearestOffset (p q : List Vec) : Option Vec :=
  if polygonsOverlap p q then some (Q.zero, Q.zero)
  else
    let fromP := p.filterMap fun c => (nearestPoint c q).map (vsub · c)
    let fromQ := q.filterMap fun c => (nearestPoint c p).map (vsub c ·)
    (fromP ++ fromQ).foldl (fun acc d => match acc with
      | none => some d
      | some e => if Q.lt (normSq d) (normSq e) then some d else some e) none
/-- The interval a polygon covers along the direction `u`, measured from `o`: (lowest, highest). -/
def span (u o : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Option (Q × Q) :=
  match poly.map fun c => dot u (vsub c o) with
  | [] => none
  | x :: xs => some (xs.foldl Q.min x, xs.foldl Q.max x)
/-- Twice the signed area of a polygon (the shoelace sum). -/
def area2 (poly : List Vec) : Q :=
  (edges poly).foldl (fun acc (a, b) => Q.add acc (cross a b)) Q.zero
/-- Whether a polygon's boundary crosses or touches itself: two edges that are not neighbours
    meet, or two neighbouring edges fold back along one line. -/
def selfIntersects (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
  let es := (edges poly).toArray
  let n := es.size
  (List.range n).any fun i => (List.range n).any fun j =>
    if j ≤ i then false
    else
      let (a, b) := es[i]!
      let (c, d) := es[j]!
      if j == i + 1 then orient a b d == 0 && Q.lt (dot (vsub b a) (vsub d c)) Q.zero
      else if i == 0 && j + 1 == n then orient c d b == 0 && Q.lt (dot (vsub d c) (vsub b a)) Q.zero
      else segmentsIntersect a b c d
/-- A simple polygon: at least three vertices, a non-zero area, and a boundary that neither crosses
    nor touches itself (a repeated vertex makes two edges that are not neighbours meet). -/
def simplePolygon (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
  poly.length ≥ 3 && !Q.isZero (area2 poly) && !selfIntersects poly
/-- Whether a point lies on a polygon's boundary. Exact. -/
def onBoundary (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
  (edges poly).any fun (a, b) => orient a b p == 0 && withinBox p a b
/-- The parameters `t` at which the line `p + t·u` meets the polygon's boundary: one per edge it
    crosses or touches, and both ends of an edge it runs along. `u` is not the zero vector. -/
def lineCrossings (p u : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : List Q :=
  (edges poly).flatMap fun (a, b) =>
    let d := vsub b a
    let w := vsub a p
    let den := cross u d
    if Q.isZero den then
      if Q.isZero (cross u w) then [Q.div (dot w u) (dot u u), Q.div (dot (vsub b p) u) (dot u u)] else []
    else
      let s := Q.div (cross w u) den
      if Q.le Q.zero s && Q.le s (Q.ofInt 1) then [Q.div (cross w d) den] else []

/-- Whether kind `a` refines kind `b`, reflexively and transitively. -/
def StructureKind.refines (a b : StructureKind) : Bool := a == b || a.ancestors.contains b

/-- Whether a source that cannot tell kind `m` (it is among `unobservedKinds`) leaves this structure's
    membership of `m`'s kinds open: always where `m` refines no kind other than an abstract one;
    otherwise only where the structure is labelled `m` or a kind `m` refines, since a structure of any
    other kind is known not to be one. -/
def Structure.maskApplies (st : Structure) (m : StructureKind) : Bool :=
  (m.parent?.filter (!·.isAbstract)).isNone || m.refines st.kind

/-- Whether a structure is of kind `k`: unknown where a kind the source cannot tell, applying to this
    structure, is `k` or a kind `k` refines (the label cannot be trusted for `k`); true where the
    structure's kind refines `k`; unknown where a kind the source cannot tell, applying to this
    structure, refines `k`; false otherwise. A parent never implies a kind refining it, two kinds
    refining one parent never imply each other, and a kind the source cannot tell never makes a known
    parent unknown. An abstract kind is the union of the kinds refining it: true where the structure
    is of one of them, unknown where it is of none and unknown for one, false otherwise. -/
def Structure.isOfKind (st : Structure) (k : StructureKind) : Option Bool :=
  let masked := st.unobservedKinds.filter st.maskApplies
  let concrete (k : StructureKind) : Option Bool :=
    if masked.any (k.refines ·) then none
    else if st.kind.refines k then some true
    else if masked.any (·.refines k) then none
    else some false
  if k.isAbstract then
    let vs := (StructureKind.all.filter (·.parent? == some k)).map concrete
    if vs.contains (some true) then some true else if vs.contains none then none else some false
  else concrete k

409	  let v := (Q.neg u.2, u.1)

418	  let p ← kin_position s x

420	  | some poly, some fp =>

422	    else

1	/-
2	  TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Unknown
3	  Typed reasons for an unknown verdict, and the three-valued result that carries them.
4	
5	  A monitor that says `unknown` without saying why is useless for diagnosis. Every place that
6	  produces `u` attaches a reason; the connectives keep the reasons of their unknown operands and
7	  drop them once a value is decided.
8	-/
9	import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Tri
10	import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Units
11	import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Handles
12	
13	namespace TrafficSpec
14	
15	inductive UnknownReason
16	  | absentAtom (name : String)            -- the source did not observe this atom for this entity
17	  | samplingGap (op : String)             -- observations too sparse for the window
18	  | windowTruncated (op : String)         -- the window reaches past the start or end of the trace
19	  | identityGap (track : TrackId)         -- a bound track is not present and no link continues it
20	  | assumptionMissing (id : AsmId)        -- an `asm.*` the scene did not supply
21	  | intentionMissing (id : IntId)         -- an `int.*` the scene did not declare for the road user at the region
22	  | parameterMissing (name : String)      -- a reading parameter the rule names but the reading lacks
23	  | unboundVariable (name : String)       -- a formula variable with no binding
24	  | compositionUnknown (rule : String)    -- a composed rule reported unknown or does not exist
25	  | outOfRange                            -- an index outside the trace
26	  | divisionByZero (what : String)
27	  | malformed (what : String)             -- a literal that names no enumeration value, wrong arity
28	  | undefined (concept : String)          -- the concept's precondition does not hold here (e.g. a multi-lane configuration)
29	  | aggregateUnresolved (id : String)     -- the posted definition of the aggregate decides neither inclusion nor exclusion of the road user's class
30	  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited
31	
32	namespace UnknownReason
33	/-- A stable spelling for reports and histograms. -/
34	def tag : UnknownReason → String
35	  | .absentAtom n => s!"absent_atom:{n}"
36	  | .samplingGap op => s!"sampling_gap:{op}"
37	  | .windowTruncated op => s!"window_truncated:{op}"
38	  | .identityGap t => s!"identity_gap:{t}"
39	  | .assumptionMissing id => s!"assumption_missing:{id}"
40	  | .intentionMissing id => s!"intention_missing:{id}"
41	  | .parameterMissing n => s!"parameter_missing:{n}"
42	  | .unboundVariable n => s!"unbound_variable:{n}"
43	  | .compositionUnknown r => s!"composition_unknown:{r}"
44	  | .outOfRange => "out_of_range"
45	  | .divisionByZero w => s!"division_by_zero:{w}"
46	  | .malformed w => s!"malformed:{w}"
47	  | .undefined c => s!"undefined:{c}"
48	  | .aggregateUnresolved id => s!"aggregate_unresolved:{id}"
49	instance : ToString UnknownReason := ⟨tag⟩
50	end UnknownReason
51	
52	/-- A three-valued result with the reasons behind an unknown one. -/
53	structure R where
54	  v : Tri
55	  why : List UnknownReason := []
56	  deriving Repr, Inhabited
57	
58	namespace R
59	def t : R := ⟨.t, []⟩
60	def f : R := ⟨.f, []⟩
61	def u (w : UnknownReason) : R := ⟨.u, [w]⟩
62	def ofBool (b : Bool) : R := ⟨Tri.ofBool b, []⟩
63	def ofOption (o : Option Bool) (w : UnknownReason) : R :=
64	  match o with
65	  | some b => ofBool b
66	  | none => u w
67	/-- Reasons are kept only while the value is undecided. -/
68	def settle (v : Tri) (why : List UnknownReason) : R := ⟨v, if v = .u then why.eraseDups else []⟩
69	@[simp] theorem settle_v (v : Tri) (why : List UnknownReason) : (settle v why).v = v := rfl
70	def and (a b : R) : R := settle (Tri.and a.v b.v) (a.why ++ b.why)
71	def or (a b : R) : R := settle (Tri.or a.v b.v) (a.why ++ b.why)
72	def not (a : R) : R := ⟨Tri.not a.v, a.why⟩
73	@[simp] theorem and_v (a b : R) : (and a b).v = Tri.and a.v b.v := rfl
74	@[simp] theorem or_v (a b : R) : (or a b).v = Tri.or a.v b.v := rfl
75	@[simp] theorem not_v (a : R) : (not a).v = Tri.not a.v := rfl
76	def implies (a b : R) : R := or (not a) b
77	def all (xs : List R) : R := xs.foldl and t
78	def any (xs : List R) : R := xs.foldl or f
79	/-- Lift an `Option α` into a computation that is unknown when the option is empty. -/
80	def bindOpt {α : Type} (o : Option α) (w : UnknownReason) (k : α → R) : R :=
81	  match o with
82	  | some a => k a
83	  | none => u w
84	end R
85	
86	/-- A quantity that may be unknown, with the reason. -/
87	abbrev QR := Except UnknownReason Q
88	
89	/-- Kleene conjunction and disjunction over index ranges of a per-instant array in O(1) each,
90	    from prefix counts and next-unknown pointers. Reasons come from the earliest unknown in range. -/
91	structure RangeAgg where
92	  vals : Array R
93	  prefF : Array Nat      -- prefF[i] = number of false values before index i
94	  prefT : Array Nat
95	  prefU : Array Nat
96	  nextU : Array Nat      -- nextU[i] = smallest k ≥ i with an unknown value (size when none)
97	
98	namespace RangeAgg
99	def build (vals : Array R) : RangeAgg :=
100	  let n := vals.size
101	  let count (p : Tri → Bool) : Array Nat :=
102	    (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i => acc.push (acc[i]! + (if p vals[i]!.v then 1 else 0))) #[0]
103	  let nextU := (List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i =>
104	    acc.set! i (if vals[i]!.v = .u then i else acc[i + 1]!)) (Array.replicate (n + 1) n)
105	  ⟨vals, count (· = .f), count (· = .t), count (· = .u), nextU⟩
106	
107	private def cnt (pref : Array Nat) (lo hi : Nat) : Nat := pref[hi + 1]! - pref[lo]!
108	private def firstUnknown (a : RangeAgg) (lo hi : Nat) : List UnknownReason :=
109	  let k := a.nextU[lo]!
110	  if k ≤ hi then a.vals[k]!.why else []
111	
112	/-- ∧ over `lo … hi` inclusive; true on an empty range. -/
113	def all (a : RangeAgg) (lo hi : Nat) : R :=
114	  if hi < lo then R.t
115	  else if cnt a.prefF lo hi > 0 then R.f
116	  else if cnt a.prefU lo hi > 0 then ⟨.u, a.firstUnknown lo hi⟩
117	  else R.t
118	/-- ∨ over `lo … hi` inclusive; false on an empty range. -/
119	def any (a : RangeAgg) (lo hi : Nat) : R :=
120	  if hi < lo then R.f
121	  else if cnt a.prefT lo hi > 0 then R.t
122	  else if cnt a.prefU lo hi > 0 then ⟨.u, a.firstUnknown lo hi⟩
123	  else R.f
124	
125	/-- The number of values among the first `m` that satisfy `p`: what `build` stores at `m`. -/
126	def countTo (vals : Array R) (p : Tri → Bool) : Nat → Nat
127	  | 0 => 0
128	  | m + 1 => countTo vals p m + (if p vals[m]!.v then 1 else 0)
129	
130	private theorem count_fold (vals : Array R) (p : Tri → Bool) (k : Nat) :
131	    ((List.range k).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i => acc.push (acc[i]! + (if p vals[i]!.v then 1 else 0))) #[0]).size = k + 1 ∧
132	    ∀ m, m ≤ k → ((List.range k).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i =>
133	      acc.push (acc[i]! + (if p vals[i]!.v then 1 else 0))) #[0])[m]! = countTo vals p m := by
134	  induction k with
135	  | zero => simp [countTo]
136	  | succ k ih =>
137	    obtain ⟨hs, hv⟩ := ih
138	    simp only [List.range_succ, List.foldl_append, List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil]
139	    refine ⟨by simp [hs], fun m hm => ?_⟩
140	    rw [getElem!_pos _ m (by simp; omega), Array.getElem_push]
141	    split
142	    · rw [← getElem!_pos _ m (by omega)]; exact hv m (by omega)
143	    · obtain rfl : m = k + 1 := by omega
144	      simp only [countTo]; rw [hv k (Nat.le_refl _)]
145	
146	theorem countTo_mono (vals : Array R) (p : Tri → Bool) {a b : Nat} (h : a ≤ b) :
147	    countTo vals p a ≤ countTo vals p b := by
148	  induction b with
149	  | zero => cases h; exact Nat.le_refl _
150	  | succ b ih =>
151	    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge a (b + 1) with h' | h'
152	    · exact Nat.le_trans (ih (by omega)) (by simp only [countTo]; omega)
153	    · obtain rfl : a = b + 1 := by omega
154	      exact Nat.le_refl _
155	
156	/-- The count rises between `lo` and `n` exactly when a value at an index in `[lo, n)` satisfies `p`. -/
157	theorem countTo_lt_iff (vals : Array R) (p : Tri → Bool) (lo n : Nat) :
158	    countTo vals p lo < countTo vals p n ↔ ∃ j, lo ≤ j ∧ j < n ∧ p vals[j]!.v := by
159	  constructor
160	  · intro h
161	    induction n with
162	    | zero => simp [countTo] at h
163	    | succ n ih =>
164	      by_cases hp : p vals[n]!.v
165	      · rcases Nat.lt_or_ge n lo with h' | h'
166	        · have := countTo_mono vals p (show n + 1 ≤ lo by omega); omega
167	        · exact ⟨n, h', Nat.lt_succ_self _, hp⟩
168	      · simp only [countTo, hp] at h
169	        obtain ⟨j, h1, h2, h3⟩ := ih (by simpa using h)
170	        exact ⟨j, h1, by omega, h3⟩
171	  · rintro ⟨j, h1, h2, h3⟩
172	    have a := countTo_mono vals p h1
173	    have b := countTo_mono vals p (show j + 1 ≤ n by omega)
174	    have c : countTo vals p (j + 1) = countTo vals p j + 1 := by simp [countTo, h3]
175	    omega
176	
177	private theorem cnt_build_f (vals : Array R) (lo hi : Nat) (hl : lo ≤ hi) (h : hi < vals.size) :
178	    cnt (build vals).prefF lo hi = countTo vals (· = .f) (hi + 1) - countTo vals (· = .f) lo := by
179	  have hf := count_fold vals (· = .f) vals.size
180	  simp only [cnt, build]
181	  rw [hf.2 (hi + 1) (by omega), hf.2 lo (by omega)]
182	
183	/-- `all` is false only on a definite false in the range. -/
184	theorem all_f_witness (vals : Array R) (lo hi : Nat) (h : ((build vals).all lo hi).v = .f) :
185	    ∃ j, lo ≤ j ∧ j ≤ hi ∧ j < vals.size ∧ vals[j]!.v = .f := by
186	  have hl : lo ≤ hi := by
187	    refine Nat.le_of_not_lt fun hn => ?_
188	    simp only [all, hn, if_true] at h
189	    exact absurd h (by decide)
190	  have hc : cnt (build vals).prefF lo hi > 0 := by
191	    refine Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun hn => ?_
192	    simp only [all, show ¬ hi < lo by omega, if_false, hn, Nat.lt_irrefl] at h
193	    split at h <;> simp [R.t] at h
194	  have hhi : hi < vals.size := by
195	    refine Nat.lt_of_not_le fun hn => ?_
196	    have hf := count_fold vals (· = .f) vals.size
197	    have : (build vals).prefF[hi + 1]! = 0 := by
198	      simp only [build]; rw [getElem!_neg]; · rfl
199	      rw [hf.1]; omega
200	    simp only [cnt, this] at hc
201	    omega
202	  rw [cnt_build_f vals lo hi hl hhi] at hc
203	  obtain ⟨j, h1, h2, h3⟩ := (countTo_lt_iff vals (· = .f) lo (hi + 1)).1 (by omega)
204	  exact ⟨j, h1, by omega, by omega, by simpa using h3⟩
205	
206	/-- A definite false in a range inside the array makes `all` false. -/
207	theorem all_f_of_witness (vals : Array R) (lo hi j : Nat) (hhi : hi < vals.size) (hlo : lo ≤ j) (hj : j ≤ hi)
208	    (hf : vals[j]!.v = .f) : (build vals).all lo hi = R.f := by
209	  have hc : cnt (build vals).prefF lo hi > 0 := by
210	    rw [cnt_build_f vals lo hi (by omega) hhi]
211	    have := (countTo_lt_iff vals (· = .f) lo (hi + 1)).2 ⟨j, hlo, by omega, by simp [hf]⟩
212	    omega
213	  simp only [all, show ¬ hi < lo by omega, if_false, hc, if_true]

/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Unknown
  Typed reasons for an unknown verdict, and the three-valued result that carries them.

  A monitor that says `unknown` without saying why is useless for diagnosis. Every place that
  produces `u` attaches a reason; the connectives keep the reasons of their unknown operands and
  drop them once a value is decided.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Tri
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Units
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Handles

namespace TrafficSpec

inductive UnknownReason
  | absentAtom (name : String)            -- the source did not observe this atom for this entity
  | samplingGap (op : String)             -- observations too sparse for the window
  | windowTruncated (op : String)         -- the window reaches past the start or end of the trace
  | identityGap (track : TrackId)         -- a bound track is not present and no link continues it
  | assumptionMissing (id : AsmId)        -- an `asm.*` the scene did not supply
  | intentionMissing (id : IntId)         -- an `int.*` the scene did not declare for the road user at the region
  | parameterMissing (name : String)      -- a reading parameter the rule names but the reading lacks
  | unboundVariable (name : String)       -- a formula variable with no binding
  | compositionUnknown (rule : String)    -- a composed rule reported unknown or does not exist
  | outOfRange                            -- an index outside the trace
  | divisionByZero (what : String)
  | malformed (what : String)             -- a literal that names no enumeration value, wrong arity
  | undefined (concept : String)          -- the concept's precondition does not hold here (e.g. a multi-lane configuration)
  | aggregateUnresolved (id : String)     -- the posted definition of the aggregate decides neither inclusion nor exclusion of the road user's class
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

namespace UnknownReason
/-- A stable spelling for reports and histograms. -/
def tag : UnknownReason → String
  | .absentAtom n => s!"absent_atom:{n}"
  | .samplingGap op => s!"sampling_gap:{op}"
  | .windowTruncated op => s!"window_truncated:{op}"
  | .identityGap t => s!"identity_gap:{t}"
  | .assumptionMissing id => s!"assumption_missing:{id}"
  | .intentionMissing id => s!"intention_missing:{id}"
  | .parameterMissing n => s!"parameter_missing:{n}"
  | .unboundVariable n => s!"unbound_variable:{n}"
  | .compositionUnknown r => s!"composition_unknown:{r}"
  | .outOfRange => "out_of_range"
  | .divisionByZero w => s!"division_by_zero:{w}"
  | .malformed w => s!"malformed:{w}"
  | .undefined c => s!"undefined:{c}"
  | .aggregateUnresolved id => s!"aggregate_unresolved:{id}"
instance : ToString UnknownReason := ⟨tag⟩
end UnknownReason

/-- A three-valued result with the reasons behind an unknown one. -/
structure R where
  v : Tri
  why : List UnknownReason := []
  deriving Repr, Inhabited

namespace R
def t : R := ⟨.t, []⟩
def f : R := ⟨.f, []⟩
def u (w : UnknownReason) : R := ⟨.u, [w]⟩
def ofBool (b : Bool) : R := ⟨Tri.ofBool b, []⟩
def ofOption (o : Option Bool) (w : UnknownReason) : R :=
  match o with
  | some b => ofBool b
  | none => u w
/-- Reasons are kept only while the value is undecided. -/
def settle (v : Tri) (why : List UnknownReason) : R := ⟨v, if v = .u then why.eraseDups else []⟩
@[simp] theorem settle_v (v : Tri) (why : List UnknownReason) : (settle v why).v = v := rfl
def and (a b : R) : R := settle (Tri.and a.v b.v) (a.why ++ b.why)
def or (a b : R) : R := settle (Tri.or a.v b.v) (a.why ++ b.why)
def not (a : R) : R := ⟨Tri.not a.v, a.why⟩
@[simp] theorem and_v (a b : R) : (and a b).v = Tri.and a.v b.v := rfl
@[simp] theorem or_v (a b : R) : (or a b).v = Tri.or a.v b.v := rfl
@[simp] theorem not_v (a : R) : (not a).v = Tri.not a.v := rfl
def implies (a b : R) : R := or (not a) b
def all (xs : List R) : R := xs.foldl and t
def any (xs : List R) : R := xs.foldl or f
/-- Lift an `Option α` into a computation that is unknown when the option is empty. -/
def bindOpt {α : Type} (o : Option α) (w : UnknownReason) (k : α → R) : R :=
  match o with
  | some a => k a
  | none => u w
end R

/-- A quantity that may be unknown, with the reason. -/
abbrev QR := Except UnknownReason Q

/-- Kleene conjunction and disjunction over index ranges of a per-instant array in O(1) each,
    from prefix counts and next-unknown pointers. Reasons come from the earliest unknown in range. -/
structure RangeAgg where
  vals : Array R
  prefF : Array Nat      -- prefF[i] = number of false values before index i
  prefT : Array Nat
  prefU : Array Nat
  nextU : Array Nat      -- nextU[i] = smallest k ≥ i with an unknown value (size when none)

namespace RangeAgg
def build (vals : Array R) : RangeAgg :=
  let n := vals.size
  let count (p : Tri → Bool) : Array Nat :=
    (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i => acc.push (acc[i]! + (if p vals[i]!.v then 1 else 0))) #[0]
  let nextU := (List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i =>
    acc.set! i (if vals[i]!.v = .u then i else acc[i + 1]!)) (Array.replicate (n + 1) n)
  ⟨vals, count (· = .f), count (· = .t), count (· = .u), nextU⟩

private def cnt (pref : Array Nat) (lo hi : Nat) : Nat := pref[hi + 1]! - pref[lo]!
private def firstUnknown (a : RangeAgg) (lo hi : Nat) : List UnknownReason :=
  let k := a.nextU[lo]!
  if k ≤ hi then a.vals[k]!.why else []

/-- ∧ over `lo … hi` inclusive; true on an empty range. -/
def all (a : RangeAgg) (lo hi : Nat) : R :=
  if hi < lo then R.t
  else if cnt a.prefF lo hi > 0 then R.f
  else if cnt a.prefU lo hi > 0 then ⟨.u, a.firstUnknown lo hi⟩
  else R.t
/-- ∨ over `lo … hi` inclusive; false on an empty range. -/
def any (a : RangeAgg) (lo hi : Nat) : R :=
  if hi < lo then R.f
  else if cnt a.prefT lo hi > 0 then R.t
  else if cnt a.prefU lo hi > 0 then ⟨.u, a.firstUnknown lo hi⟩
  else R.f

/-- The number of values among the first `m` that satisfy `p`: what `build` stores at `m`. -/
def countTo (vals : Array R) (p : Tri → Bool) : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 0
  | m + 1 => countTo vals p m + (if p vals[m]!.v then 1 else 0)

private theorem count_fold (vals : Array R) (p : Tri → Bool) (k : Nat) :
    ((List.range k).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i => acc.push (acc[i]! + (if p vals[i]!.v then 1 else 0))) #[0]).size = k + 1 ∧
    ∀ m, m ≤ k → ((List.range k).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i =>
      acc.push (acc[i]! + (if p vals[i]!.v then 1 else 0))) #[0])[m]! = countTo vals p m := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [countTo]
  | succ k ih =>
    obtain ⟨hs, hv⟩ := ih
    simp only [List.range_succ, List.foldl_append, List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil]
    refine ⟨by simp [hs], fun m hm => ?_⟩
    rw [getElem!_pos _ m (by simp; omega), Array.getElem_push]
    split
    · rw [← getElem!_pos _ m (by omega)]; exact hv m (by omega)
    · obtain rfl : m = k + 1 := by omega
      simp only [countTo]; rw [hv k (Nat.le_refl _)]

theorem countTo_mono (vals : Array R) (p : Tri → Bool) {a b : Nat} (h : a ≤ b) :
    countTo vals p a ≤ countTo vals p b := by
  induction b with
  | zero => cases h; exact Nat.le_refl _
  | succ b ih =>
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge a (b + 1) with h' | h'
    · exact Nat.le_trans (ih (by omega)) (by simp only [countTo]; omega)
    · obtain rfl : a = b + 1 := by omega
      exact Nat.le_refl _

/-- The count rises between `lo` and `n` exactly when a value at an index in `[lo, n)` satisfies `p`. -/
theorem countTo_lt_iff (vals : Array R) (p : Tri → Bool) (lo n : Nat) :
    countTo vals p lo < countTo vals p n ↔ ∃ j, lo ≤ j ∧ j < n ∧ p vals[j]!.v := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    induction n with
    | zero => simp [countTo] at h
    | succ n ih =>
      by_cases hp : p vals[n]!.v
      · rcases Nat.lt_or_ge n lo with h' | h'
        · have := countTo_mono vals p (show n + 1 ≤ lo by omega); omega
        · exact ⟨n, h', Nat.lt_succ_self _, hp⟩
      · simp only [countTo, hp] at h
        obtain ⟨j, h1, h2, h3⟩ := ih (by simpa using h)
        exact ⟨j, h1, by omega, h3⟩
  · rintro ⟨j, h1, h2, h3⟩
    have a := countTo_mono vals p h1
    have b := countTo_mono vals p (show j + 1 ≤ n by omega)
    have c : countTo vals p (j + 1) = countTo vals p j + 1 := by simp [countTo, h3]
    omega

private theorem cnt_build_f (vals : Array R) (lo hi : Nat) (hl : lo ≤ hi) (h : hi < vals.size) :
    cnt (build vals).prefF lo hi = countTo vals (· = .f) (hi + 1) - countTo vals (· = .f) lo := by
  have hf := count_fold vals (· = .f) vals.size
  simp only [cnt, build]
  rw [hf.2 (hi + 1) (by omega), hf.2 lo (by omega)]

/-- `all` is false only on a definite false in the range. -/
theorem all_f_witness (vals : Array R) (lo hi : Nat) (h : ((build vals).all lo hi).v = .f) :
    ∃ j, lo ≤ j ∧ j ≤ hi ∧ j < vals.size ∧ vals[j]!.v = .f := by
  have hl : lo ≤ hi := by
    refine Nat.le_of_not_lt fun hn => ?_
    simp only [all, hn, if_true] at h
    exact absurd h (by decide)
  have hc : cnt (build vals).prefF lo hi > 0 := by
    refine Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun hn => ?_
    simp only [all, show ¬ hi < lo by omega, if_false, hn, Nat.lt_irrefl] at h
    split at h <;> simp [R.t] at h
  have hhi : hi < vals.size := by
    refine Nat.lt_of_not_le fun hn => ?_
    have hf := count_fold vals (· = .f) vals.size
    have : (build vals).prefF[hi + 1]! = 0 := by
      simp only [build]; rw [getElem!_neg]; · rfl
      rw [hf.1]; omega
    simp only [cnt, this] at hc
    omega
  rw [cnt_build_f vals lo hi hl hhi] at hc
  obtain ⟨j, h1, h2, h3⟩ := (countTo_lt_iff vals (· = .f) lo (hi + 1)).1 (by omega)
  exact ⟨j, h1, by omega, by omega, by simpa using h3⟩

/-- A definite false in a range inside the array makes `all` false. -/
theorem all_f_of_witness (vals : Array R) (lo hi j : Nat) (hhi : hi < vals.size) (hlo : lo ≤ j) (hj : j ≤ hi)
    (hf : vals[j]!.v = .f) : (build vals).all lo hi = R.f := by
  have hc : cnt (build vals).prefF lo hi > 0 := by
    rw [cnt_build_f vals lo hi (by omega) hhi]
    have := (countTo_lt_iff vals (· = .f) lo (hi + 1)).2 ⟨j, hlo, by omega, by simp [hf]⟩
    omega
  simp only [all, show ¬ hi < lo by omega, if_false, hc, if_true]
end RangeAgg

end TrafficSpec

/-
  Witnesses for LVMC_11_40_140_o1.

  Geometry (metres, +x east, +y north). A roadway (y 0–10) and a sidewalk (y 10–13) run east–west
  along x −30…30. The highway region (the public way) covers roadway and sidewalk, up to y 13, or
  up to y 15 where a strip behind the walk (the apron of a driveway) lies in the right-of-way.
  A driveway / alley entrance region (x −3…3) runs north from the walk (y 13–30), or from y 10
  where the sidewalk area extends across it. An alley (x −3…3, y 13–40, or 10–40) is itself a
  public way, mapped under its own highway region.
  The rider's body is 1.8 m long and 0.6 m wide (half-extents 0.9 / 0.3 / 0.6 m), heading along
  its motion, so the ground distance from the body to the walk is |y − 13| − 0.9 (north of the
  walk) or 10 − y − 0.9 (south of it). Instants are 1 s apart. With p.stop_point_tolerance = 2 m
  the approach observations sit at 2.6 m or more (outside the zone) and the zone observations at
  0.1–0.7 m; a moving rider goes 1–4 m/s, a halt is 0 m/s (p.halt_speed_tolerance = 0.1 m/s).
  Every figure here is the witness's own and appears nowhere in the rule.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Rules.LVMC_11.LVMC_11_40_140_o1
import TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.Builders

namespace TrafficSpecWitness.LVMC_11_40_140_o1

open TrafficSpec

def m (n : Int) : Q := Units.metres n
def cm (n : Int) : Q := Units.centimetres n

-- Binders ↦ tracks: subject ↦ 1

/-- The rider's half-extents. -/
def body : Q × Q × Q := (cm 90, cm 30, cm 60)

def asmId : AsmId := "asm.business_or_residence_district"

-- Regions.
def roadway : Structure := Build.rect 1 .roadway (m (-30)) (m 0) (m 30) (m 10)
def sidewalk : Structure := Build.rect 2 .sidewalk (m (-30)) (m 10) (m 30) (m 13)
/-- The public way up to the back of the walk. -/
def highway13 : Structure := Build.rect 3 .highway (m (-30)) (m 0) (m 30) (m 13)
/-- The public way including a 2 m strip behind the walk. -/
def highway15 : Structure := Build.rect 3 .highway (m (-30)) (m 0) (m 30) (m 15)
/-- A driveway entrance behind the walk. -/
def driveway : Structure := Build.rect 4 .drivewayOrAlleyEntrance (m (-3)) (m 13) (m 3) (m 30)
/-- A driveway entrance the sidewalk area extends across. -/
def drivewayAcross : Structure := Build.rect 4 .drivewayOrAlleyEntrance (m (-3)) (m 10) (m 3) (m 30)
/-- Two sidewalk regions meeting at x = 0 (idle). -/
def sidewalkWest : Structure := Build.rect 2 .sidewalk (m (-30)) (m 10) (m 0) (m 13)
def sidewalkEast : Structure := Build.rect 5 .sidewalk (m 0) (m 10) (m 30) (m 13)
/-- An alley behind the walk, and the public way it is. -/
def alley : Structure := Build.rect 6 .alley (m (-3)) (m 13) (m 3) (m 40)
def alleyWay : Structure := Build.rect 7 .highway (m (-3)) (m 13) (m 3) (m 40)
/-- An alley the sidewalk area extends across, and the public way it is. -/
def alleyAcross : Structure := Build.rect 6 .alley (m (-3)) (m 10) (m 3) (m 40)
def alleyAcrossWay : Structure := Build.rect 7 .highway (m (-3)) (m 10) (m 3) (m 40)

/-- The driveway layout of forbid / permit / blind / history_boundary. -/
def drivewayLayout : List Structure := [roadway, sidewalk, highway15, driveway]

/-- One observation of the rider: x, y (cm), heading, speed (m/s). -/
abbrev Pose := Int × Int × Vec × Int

/-- A trace of the rider (track 1, the subject) along `path`, 1 s apart, among `sts`, with the
    district assumption declared `district`. -/
def pathTrace (cls : List RoadUserClass) (sts : List Structure) (district : Bool)
    (path : List Pose) : Trace :=
  Build.trace path.length 0 (Units.seconds 1) fun k t =>
    let (x, y, h, v) := path.getD k (0, 0, Build.east, 0)
    Build.scene t (some 1)
      [ Build.user 1 cls (cm x, cm y) h (Units.metresPerSecond v) body ]
      sts
      []
      (assumptions := [(asmId, district)])

/-- Out of the driveway: 10.1, 6.1, 2.6 m from the walk, then 0.6 m (zone, on the apron inside the
    public way), then on the walk, then on the roadway; never slower than 2 m/s. -/
def emergeNoHalt : List Pose :=
  [ (0, 2400, Build.south, 4), (0, 2000, Build.south, 4), (0, 1650, Build.south, 3)
  , (0, 1450, Build.south, 2), (0, 1150, Build.south, 3), (0, 800, Build.south, 3) ]

/-- From the roadway northwards: 7.1, 3.1 m from the walk, 0.6 m (zone), on the walk, then on. -/
def fromRoadway (last : List Pose) : List Pose :=
  [ (0, 200, Build.north, 4), (0, 600, Build.north, 3), (0, 850, Build.north, 2)
  , (0, 1150, Build.north, 3) ] ++ last

/-- `forbid` (violated): In a declared residence district a bicycle rides out of a driveway entrance and onto the sidewalk without its speed falling to the halt tolerance while within the stopping zone; it was farther than the tolerance from the sidewalk earlier in the recording. -/
def forbidTrace : Trace := pathTrace [.bicycle] drivewayLayout true emergeNoHalt

/-- `permit` (compliant): The same bicycle halts just short of the sidewalk, within the stopping zone and outside the sidewalk, then rides onto it. -/
def permitTrace : Trace :=
  pathTrace [.bicycle] drivewayLayout true
    [ (0, 2400, Build.south, 4), (0, 2000, Build.south, 4), (0, 1650, Build.south, 3)
    , (0, 1450, Build.south, 0)      -- halt 0.6 m from the walk
    , (0, 1400, Build.south, 1)      -- creeps on, 0.1 m from the walk
    , (0, 1150, Build.south, 3), (0, 800, Build.south, 3) ]

/-- `idle` (not_applicable): An electric scooter rides along the sidewalk from one sidewalk region into the next, coming from the sidewalk, not from an alley, a driveway or off the public way. -/
def idleTrace : Trace :=
  pathTrace [.electricScooter] [roadway, sidewalkWest, sidewalkEast, highway13] true
    [ (-600, 1150, Build.east, 3), (-300, 1150, Build.east, 3)
    , (100, 1150, Build.east, 3)     -- onto the eastern sidewalk region, from the western one
    , (500, 800, Build.south, 3), (500, 500, Build.south, 3) ]

/-- `blind` (unknown): A bicycle emerges from a driveway onto the sidewalk with no halt recorded, and the source maps regions without their outline, so the stopping zone and the approach start cannot be read.
    The bicycle rides along the walk, turns into the driveway, stands once at its turn-round (whether
    within the zone the outline-less map cannot tell), and comes back out onto the walk without
    another halt. -/
def blindTrace : Trace :=
  pathTrace [.bicycle] drivewayLayout true
    [ (-800, 1150, Build.east, 3), (-400, 1150, Build.east, 3)
    , (0, 1450, Build.north, 2), (0, 1800, Build.north, 2)
    , (0, 1900, Build.south, 0)
    , (0, 1650, Build.south, 2), (0, 1450, Build.south, 2)
    , (0, 1150, Build.south, 3), (0, 800, Build.south, 3) ]

/-- `history_boundary` (unknown): The recording begins with the electric bicycle already within the stopping zone, moving out of a driveway; it enters the sidewalk with no halt recorded, and the search reaches the start of the recording without reaching the approach start. -/
def history_boundaryTrace : Trace :=
  pathTrace [.electricBicycle] drivewayLayout true
    [ (0, 1460, Build.south, 2), (0, 1400, Build.south, 1)
    , (0, 1150, Build.south, 3), (0, 800, Build.south, 3) ]

/-- `branch_1` (not_applicable): The same driveway exit without a halt, in a place the map's reading declares outside any business or residence district. -/
def branch_1Trace : Trace := pathTrace [.bicycle] drivewayLayout false emergeNoHalt

/-- `branch_2` (violated): an electric bicycle emerges from an alley (a public way) onto the walk without halting. -/
def branch_2Trace : Trace :=
  pathTrace [.electricBicycle] [roadway, sidewalk, highway13, alley, alleyWay] true emergeNoHalt

/-- `branch_3` (violated): a bicycle crosses from the roadway onto the sidewalk area across an alley, entering the alley, without halting. -/
def branch_3Trace : Trace :=
  pathTrace [.bicycle] [roadway, sidewalk, highway13, alleyAcross, alleyAcrossWay] true
    (fromRoadway [(0, 1600, Build.north, 3), (0, 2000, Build.north, 3)])

/-- `branch_4` (violated): a bicycle crosses from the roadway onto the sidewalk area across a driveway, entering the driveway, without halting. -/
def branch_4Trace : Trace :=
  pathTrace [.bicycle] [roadway, sidewalk, highway15, drivewayAcross] true
    (fromRoadway [(0, 1450, Build.north, 2), (0, 1480, Build.north, 0)])

  enters the sidewalk.

  - (i) the subject is in an alley or a driveway/alley entrance at the entry, or was at the
    observation before. Written as `AD ∨ rises ¬AD`.
  - (ii) at the observation before, the subject was in no highway region. Written as
    `rises H`. When H holds at the entry, this is exactly "no highway region before". When H
    does not hold at the entry, alternative (iii) is already true at the entry, so the whole
    `or` gives the same result as the record's wording.
  - (iii) `until (rel_occupies subject s) (¬H)`.

  - The stopping zone is: not on s, and `st_region_geometry_distance(subject, s) ≤
    p.stop_point_tolerance`.
  - The search is `since Zone (Zone ∧ drv_motion_complete_halt(subject; p.halt_speed_tolerance))`.
    It ends at the approach start or at the previous time the subject occupied s. It is unknown
    when it reaches the start of the recording, or when the distance or occupancy is unobserved.
  - The search is read at the observation before the entry, written `rises ¬search`. At the
    entry the search is decided false because the subject occupies s.
- **Rule 3c**: the obligation repeats the applicability's full selection of s, under a
  `forallRegion sidewalk`.

| `branch_5` | violated | Leaving a building, through `rises H` |
| `branch_6` | violated | Entering a building, through `until` |

| `branch_8` | not applicable | A pedestrian, so all three class aggregates are false |

  `rises` cannot be read (`windowTruncated rises`), because the scooter (idle) and the bicycle
  (blind) are already on a sidewalk.

- The planned narrative is "no halt recorded". With geometry masked, a recording with no halt
  can never be unknown only because geometry is missing:

    `windowTruncated since`. The gate rejects that reason on a witness with no history
    boundary.

  4. comes back out with no further halt.
- The result is unknown only because of `st.region_geometry`.
- Recommendation for the planner: the blind narrative should allow a recorded halt whose place
  relative to the zone cannot be read.

The gate returned `OK`.
